:root{font:15px/1.5 system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;color:#242424;background:#f2f2f2;color-scheme:light}*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0}header,main,footer{max-width:1460px;margin:auto;padding:20px 28px}header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid #b5b5b5}h1{font-size:1.7rem;margin:0}header p{margin:4px 0;color:#555}.eyebrow{text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.75rem;letter-spacing:.06em}nav,.actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}nav{align-self:flex-start;padding-top:14px}a{color:#292929;text-underline-offset:3px}nav a{padding:6px}section{background:white;border:1px solid #c3c3c3;border-radius:3px;padding:18px;margin-bottom:16px;min-width:0}.section-heading{display:flex;align-items:start;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}h2{font-size:1.15rem;margin:0 0 12px}h3{font-size:1rem;margin:18px 0 9px}p{margin:8px 0 14px}.review-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 330px;gap:16px}aside{min-width:0}fieldset{border:0;padding:0;margin:0;min-width:0}legend{font-weight:600;padding:0 0 10px}label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;margin:12px 0;font-size:.88rem;font-weight:600;min-width:0}input,select,textarea,button{font:inherit}input,select,textarea{width:100%;min-width:0;padding:8px;border:1px solid #949494;border-radius:2px;background:#fff;color:#222}input[readonly]{background:#f1f1f1}input[type=checkbox]{width:auto}textarea{font:13px/1.5 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace;resize:vertical}button,.file-control{padding:8px 11px;border:1px solid #777;border-radius:2px;background:#eee;color:#222;font-weight:550;cursor:pointer}button:hover{background:#ddd}.primary{background:#333;color:#fff}.primary:hover{background:#111}button:disabled,fieldset:disabled,input:disabled,textarea:disabled{opacity:.6;cursor:not-allowed}:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #555;outline-offset:3px}.actions{margin:12px 0}.file-control{font-weight:500;margin:0}.file-control input{font-size:.8rem;max-width:270px;padding:3px}.checkbox{flex-direction:row;align-items:start;font-weight:500}.checkbox input{margin-top:4px}.muted{color:#5b5b5b;font-size:.86rem}.badge{font-size:.78rem;border:1px solid #aaa;background:#f2f2f2;padding:3px 8px;max-width:100%}dl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(100px,180px) minmax(0,1fr);gap:6px 12px;font-size:.88rem}dt{color:#555}dd{margin:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}pre{font:12px/1.5 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;max-height:500px;overflow:auto;padding:12px;border:1px solid #ddd;background:#f5f5f5}details{margin:12px 0}summary{font-size:.88rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}.preserve-lines{white-space:pre-wrap}.file-pin{overflow-wrap:anywhere;font:12px/1.5 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace}.table-wrap{overflow:auto;border:1px solid #ddd}table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:.84rem}th,td{padding:9px;text-align:left;vertical-align:top;border-bottom:1px solid #ddd}th{background:#eee}td:first-child{overflow-wrap:anywhere;max-width:320px}td:nth-child(4){font:11px/1.5 ui-monospace,monospace;overflow-wrap:anywhere;max-width:190px}td button{font-size:.8rem;padding:5px 7px}#notice,#conflict-panel,#incoming{border:2px solid #777;background:#fafafa;padding:14px;margin:12px 0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}#notice[data-level=error]{border-left:7px solid #333}article{padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #ddd}article p{font-size:.85rem;overflow-wrap:anywhere}article button{margin:4px 6px 4px 0}#edition-detail p{font-size:.86rem}footer{font-size:.8rem;color:#555}[hidden]{display:none!important}@media(max-width:1000px){.review-grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}header{flex-direction:column;gap:8px}nav{padding-top:0}}@media(max-width:600px){header,main,footer{padding:14px 12px}section{padding:13px}.section-heading{flex-direction:column}dl{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:2px}dd{margin-bottom:8px}.actions{align-items:stretch}.actions>button{flex:1 1
